name: Loramus and the demon hunter’s counsel

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

summary: The chain reaches Loramus Thalipedes on Azshara’s cold eastern shore. In the Classic quest account, the demon hunter helps direct the work that lies ahead: learn the demon’s true name and prepare a means to challenge him. The coast is broad and wind-cut, a different world from the Blasted Lands’ dry scar. This telling uses Loramus’s Classic-era counsel only; later retellings of his story do not replace what this quest chain records.
